projectDescription: A multi-tenant AI-powered financial management platform for CFO teams and their clients, featuring live financial models, metrics, dashboards, and automated agent workflows.
keyFeatures: Multi-tenant client portal for CFO teams
Live financial metrics connected to General Ledger (QuickBooks, Xero, Puzzle)
Free-form Notion-style dashboard pages with financial widgets
AI agents for scheduled workflows and financial Q&A
Automated Slack reports with live data on a cadence
Business context layer for AI-aware financial models
Playbooks and templates for reusable dashboard setups
MCP/WebMCP export for external agent integrations
Piggy AI companion for in-app guidance and CFO-level advice
Flat-fee pricing per client with flexible extra usage
publicApiSurface: MCP server endpoint for external agent integrations
WebMCP export for external AI clients
General Ledger connections (QuickBooks Online, Xero, Puzzle)
Bank account and credit card balance connections
Metrics API (create, update, read live metrics)
Slack webhook delivery for automated reports
